document: Matched history and live-command qualification contract
scope: Synthetic R07 candidates. Not target Clutter API schemas or production IPC.

interpretation.pass: Executed fixture assertions met, including applied inverse when requested.
interpretation.refused: Foreign work preserved by visible refusal; not counted as applied undo.
interpretation.gap: Required behaviour absent without corruption; not a pass.
interpretation.strict: Exit1 for gaps/failures or refusal of a declared disjoint safe inverse; discovery0 only means no unexpected failure, not architecture accepted.

cases.fixture: Nested foreign text inside own insertion
assertions: Redo restores own text or is a no-op after refused undo
Record broad refusals as unqualified UX

cases.fixture: Foreign text in own added row
assertions: Preserve foreign text or explicitly refuse inverse

cases.fixture: Foreign text in own added column
assertions: Preserve foreign text or explicitly refuse inverse

cases.fixture: Foreign text disjoint from own added row
assertions: Remove own empty row without removing disjoint text
Live accepted state and both views agree
All routes execute the same dispatcher
Reject changed payload for used id
One acceptance for same expected version
Accepted edit queryable through MCP outcome
Do not apply stale command to fresh document

limits: Browser-owned authority reached via Playwright test relay; not production desktop IPC.
Target stable IDs, auth/grants, disk outcomes, restart ownership and provider semantics remain separate.
Existing raw PM/Y structural failures stay diagnostic controls.
